status_after_values.executed_not_violation: the run executed and demonstrates no violation
status_after_values.experimentally_verified: the claim is demonstrated by the observed run
status_after_values.experimentally_verified_provisional: the run is observed but the L5 claim is provisional
status_after_values.reported_claim: nothing was executed that asserts the claim

analyst_review.tests_field: tests lists the test functions or PoC script paths the record observed. It is empty only where the run reported no named test (vyper-optimizer-ternary); there the stdout CHECK markers cited in evidence are the assertion record.

verdict_definitions.SUPPORTED: a cited test satisfies rule 1a, 1b or 1c from the committed artefact bytes; L5 stands
verdict_definitions.UNSUPPORTED: rule 3: the artefact observed nothing (empty stdout or absent test: L1) or the record's own text classifies it (negative control / mitigated in practice: L4)
verdict_definitions.WEAK: rule 2: the run is present and passed but the artefact records no claim-specific observation; L4, provisional L5 candidate

rule.supported_1a: the artefact's expectation.declared names the cited test in a fail list, the artefact records the test failing, and the [FAIL: <reason>] reason is non-empty
rule.supported_1b: the artefact's expectation.declared uses stdout_contains (a declared differential/observation harness) and the expectation is met with the named lines present in stdout.txt
rule.supported_1c: the cited test passed and its Logs block in stdout.txt contains at least one `= <numeric value>` line: the harness printed the affected quantity, so the state is observed, not merely executed
rule.unsupported: (i) the cited artefact's stdout is empty or the cited test is absent from it: L1, insufficient_evidence; or (ii) the record's own published text classifies it as a negative control or as mitigated in practice: L4, reason names the class. L4/L1, never L0: attribution, ids, provenance, outcome and why_no_L6 stay intact
